name: local-router
description: Routes each subagent to a model by task complexity, locally: heavy work to Opus, light checks to Sonnet, read-only research to Haiku. No network, no server.

enabled.title: Routing enabled
enabled.description: Turn off to let every spawn run exactly as Claude proposed.

heavy_model.title: Heavy tasks
heavy_model.description: Model for build, implement, fix, refactor, design, review and plan tasks.

light_model.title: Light tasks
light_model.description: Model for validate, verify, compare, summarize and test-writing tasks.

trivial_model.title: Trivial tasks
trivial_model.description: Model for research, search, find and other read-only work.

show_toasts.title: Show a toast per routed spawn
show_toasts.description: One line to you, never to the model, each time a spawn's model is changed.
